title: Count restrictions to prove lower bounds despite coefficient cancellation
summary: A compact counting proof pattern for sparse signed representations: count restrictions on which each candidate summand can meet a necessary degree condition, rather than counting only its original support.
content: Over any odd-characteristic field, representing parity on n Boolean variables as a linear combination of subcube indicators requires at least ceil((3/2)^n) atoms, allowing arbitrary coefficients and cancellation. Count all 3^n partial assignments: restricted parity retains a nonzero top-degree coefficient, while each atom can supply that coefficient on exactly 2^n restrictions.
whenToUse: A compact counting proof pattern for sparse signed representations: count restrictions on which each candidate summand can meet a necessary degree condition, rather than counting only its original support.
limitations: The atom dictionary is essential. Entangled or otherwise richer atoms are not covered. Project-specific orbit bounds require the explicitly described dictionary transformation.
